follows.supersedes: the F (flow record) and operations sections of council_trend_v1_draft_dobby_20261106.json (61c02a42); those are withdrawn here

scope: document only: names, inputs, outputs and timing of each evidence axis so that later specs can be frozen one at a time; no execution cadence, threshold, operation or approval is implied; online delta-rule updates count as model training and fall under the same scope control as fits
accepted_corrections: Env.obs global input is 6 fields (4 clock/market + cash weight + log NAV), not 4
v2_fly.json does not establish equivalence to random wiring or a cash effect; it is one unpinned comparison
Fly online delta updates are training and need maturity and scope controls
the owner's 'not minute-level' is not an approval of a daily-close/next-open operating cadence
data.py full-period nanstd scaling and backfill, and env.Panel.closing from the next row, block any performance claim until replaced by time-local, known-at-time versions

common_causal_contract.as_of: every output carries as_of = the KR session date D and the clock 'close of D' (KST); inputs are restricted to completed bars with provenance fetched_at >= D 15:31:00+09:00 (same rule as dobby_kr_core_v1) and to account state known at that time
common_causal_contract.input_window: only data with session <= D; features are computed from the asset's own completed closes/opens; no cross-file implicit substitution of fetch times
common_causal_contract.maturity: a label for decision D with horizon H sessions matures at the open of session D+H+1 (same convention as the B teacher); no component may be updated with a label before its maturity, and evaluation splits purge H+1 sessions at boundaries
common_causal_contract.scaling: any standardization uses statistics from sessions <= fit cutoff only (train-only scales); full-period scales are forbidden
common_causal_contract.calendar: sessions come from a known-at-time exchange calendar file with provenance, never from the next row's presence
provenance_fields: code sha256 of the producing module

fields: confidence_basis (what the confidence is derived from: sample count, agreement, past calibration, none)
evidence (ids of inputs or retrieved cases)
output_envelope_per_axis.rule: a component that cannot fill calibration_status honestly writes 'uncalibrated'; scores and probabilities are never relabelled as each other

B_direction_opinion.question: at close D, which cost-inclusive one-share action value is higher over the next 20 sessions: buy now vs stay in cash (held 0) or keep vs sell now (held 1)?
B_direction_opinion.inputs: the frozen 6 features at D (5 price + held)
B_direction_opinion.output: value_type score (signed contrast), calibration uncalibrated, horizon 20, label as in the B teacher, maturity open of D+21
B_direction_opinion.model: frozen yearly B fits of result 0b10b9da applied only in their own execution year

T_state_recognition.question: at close D, is the current trend state down / up / neutral?
T_state_recognition.inputs: 5 frozen price features + logret120, 20-session log-price slope, drawdown from the 60-session rolling peak, down-closes in the last 10 sessions, sd60/sd20; all from closes <= D
T_state_recognition.output: value_type probability vector over {down, up, neutral}; calibration_status reported separately for synthetic regimes and for real proxy events; horizon n/a (state), label_definition names the generator mapping as a declared assumption
T_state_recognition.learner: to be fixed by bill (LightGBM multiclass proposed); training labels only from generated training paths; no real-label fitting in v1

T_forward_risk.question: at close D, will a drawdown event occur within the next 20 sessions?

two_named_definitions_to_choose_before_a.E_close: min over sessions D+1..D+20 of close_s / close_D - 1 <= -5%
two_named_definitions_to_choose_before_a.E_peak: max over s in D+1..D+20 of (close_s / max(close_D..close_s) - 1) <= -5% (drawdown from the running peak inside the window)

T_forward_risk.output: probability or score with explicit calibration_status; horizon 20; maturity open of D+21
T_forward_risk.rule: the definition is frozen in the spec before any run and never changed after observing results

F1_fly_trend_risk_head.question: same two questions as T (state at D; forward event within 20 sessions), answered by heads on the sparse KC representation
F1_fly_trend_risk_head.inputs: daily feature vector at D (same as T inputs) -> random projection -> connectome PN->KC -> top-k code z_D; training windows = all eligible dated sessions, not only B buy proposals
F1_fly_trend_risk_head.learning: delta-rule readouts updated only with matured labels (open of D+21); each update is training and is logged with as_of and label maturity
F1_fly_trend_risk_head.controls: degree/weight-matched rewired Fly, frozen (no-learning) Fly, and a native-feature logistic baseline with the same inputs/targets/budget; several predeclared seeds
F1_fly_trend_risk_head.output: state scores and forward-event score, calibration uncalibrated unless a nested calibration set is declared; horizon 20; maturity open of D+21
F1_fly_trend_risk_head.caveat: the current avoid readout and 7-panel-row horizon are not transplanted

F2_fly_similar_cases.question: which earlier sessions had the most similar sparse code to D, and what happened after them (matured outcomes only)?
F2_fly_similar_cases.inputs: KC codes of sessions s <= D - 21 (so every retrieved case has a matured 20-session outcome at D); near-duplicate exclusion: no two retrieved cases within 10 sessions of each other
F2_fly_similar_cases.output: value_type ranked_list of {session, similarity, matured 20-session return, max drawdown in window, label E_close/E_peak}; coverage = number of eligible cases; outcome distribution of the top-k; confidence_basis = sample count k and similarity spread
F2_fly_similar_cases.rule: no session later than D - 21 may be retrieved or described; similarity is evidence of resemblance, not of a rebound
F2_fly_similar_cases.use: shown to Jev and to the owner as dated examples; in v1 it changes no decision

R_rules_feasibility.question: given a target weight, what integer quantity is affordable at the assumed fill with costs, and do position rules (entry basis, sessions since entry, peak giveback) fire?
R_rules_feasibility.inputs: account state known at D, next-open input with its own observation time, rule parameters frozen in advance
R_rules_feasibility.output: computed quantity (not an order) and the list of fired rules with their inputs
R_rules_feasibility.implementation: dobby_kr_core_v1 quantity() for sizing; rules as explicit predicates; the bill.py guard stays in the execution layer and judges book conditions only

stage_1_blind.inputs: a dated daily chart image of sessions D-119..D (close, MA20, MA200, volume) rendered from completed bars only, plus the plain facts: last close, 5/20/60-session returns, drawdown from the 60-session peak; no B/T/F outputs, no account state
stage_1_blind.question: is the current trend down, up or unclear? would you buy, hold, sell or wait at the next open? one-line reason; confidence low/medium/high
stage_1_blind.output: label + action + reason + stated confidence; calibration uncalibrated; the stated confidence is not an outcome probability

stage_2_deliberation_optional.inputs: the stage-1 answer plus the other axes' outputs and F2 retrieved cases with dates
stage_2_deliberation_optional.question: do you change your view? why?
stage_2_deliberation_optional.output: revised label/action + which evidence changed it
stage_2_deliberation_optional.rule: stage 1 is recorded before stage 2 inputs exist, so incremental information can be measured

J_jev_blind_first_opinion.cost_and_scope: one or two free-model calls per session; no calls in this document phase; calls begin only under a frozen spec
J_jev_blind_first_opinion.note: the existing jev_client questions are intraday 5-60 minute scalping questions and are not reused for the daily task

aggregate_deferred.rule: no aggregate (vote, gate, weighting) is defined in v1; each axis is recorded separately with its own matured scoring; aggregates are proposed only after locked ablations (B-only, leave-one-expert-out) show added value
aggregate_deferred.note: a theta on an uncalibrated score is an engineering choice and would need its own rung

endpoints_kept_apart: state recognition vs generated regimes (synthetic check/test paths)
real forward-event detection: precision/recall/false alarms, log-loss and Brier where probabilities are claimed, detection delay and warning persistence
ledger outcomes only with the audited ledger and costs, with yearly B folds
evaluation_design_for_later_specs.uncertainty: chronological block summaries; no independent-row confidence intervals on overlapping windows
evaluation_design_for_later_specs.selection: no winner selection on test; seeds and thresholds predeclared

explicitly_not_in_this_document: Fly transplant of current avoid weights
open_for_bill: E_close vs E_peak as the single forward-event definition
k and the near-duplicate window for F2 (drafted k=10, 10 sessions)
whether T and F1 share the exact same input vector (drafted yes, for comparability)
Jev stage 2 included in v1 or deferred
